provenance.baselineCompilerRelocation: Only two static import specifiers use absolute file URLs; both dependency sources equal the original Git versions.

method.timing: Serial uninstrumented capturePhysical (1024-frame blocks) or run(N) calls only. Fresh reset instance for every run. Explicit WASM module compilation, construction, input submission, retained-output concatenation, snapshots, assertions and hashing are outside timers. Public API batch copying and any engine tiering during those calls remain included.
method.order: One discarded run per case/variant, then alternate baseline/candidate and candidate/baseline pairs. Warmup is min(4096,frames) or min(100000,instructions). No forced GC, affinity or V8 flags.
method.attribution: Identical native runtime, original versus current compiler. All modules are generated and compiled before warmup, then bound as precompiled modules to fresh native memory outside execution timers.
method.coldTranslation: Generation and WASM compilation times are single startup observations per case/variant, outside execution timers. They are retained as diagnostics, not stable cold-start performance estimates.
method.constructor: Pre-generated bytes and manifest are supplied to each fresh instance. The current loader constructs its own WebAssembly.Module from those bytes, outside execution timers, even when the artifact includes a module. Startup observations exclude this repeated validation/compilation; they do not measure total construction cost.
method.parity: Exact chip state and all diagnostics, registers/IO/SRAM/Flash/EEPROM/IRQ frames, raw Float32 PCM and remaining pins at each checkpoint. Exact cross-trial baseline state. No scheduling-hint normalization. Kernel counts/registers/cycles and constant-low PCM are additional checks.
method.scope: Firmware: 250ms by default, compatible clock and fixed-ps resumable CPU. Kernels: three-ALU and thirty-ALU loops for direct throughput; short-loop internal20MHz and finite 20MHz CLKI /1,/256 at25ms; every source edge still serviced.
method.limits: Node host timing with CPU, peripherals, native pin/audio integration and JS batch copying coupled. No DSP filtering or browser latency guarantee. Scheduling, tiering and GC may affect samples.
